findings.failure_path: Replacing an existing skill or hook file with a symlink produces Git change type T, which ACMRD excludes. A PR containing only such changes reaches review_evidence_not_required and exits 0 without any review evidence.
findings.smallest_fix: Include type changes in path discovery and add a regular-file-to-symlink regression requiring review evidence.

findings.failure_path: A PR can record a genuine wording-only review, then add behavioral hook changes without running a challenge. Any passed wording_only_scope sets the global exemption, so the gate accepts the expanded non-wording PR with zero challenge results. No forged receipt is necessary.
findings.smallest_fix: Require the whole PR’s current scope to qualify as wording-only before waiving challenge presence; add a mixed wording/behavior regression. This does not require binding review receipts to candidate hashes.

findings.failure_path: Evidence gap: the packet omits the citing ledger rows and resolver ingestion/table-selection code, controller argument and chain handlers, OpenCode prependTaskContext implementation, and deleted binder/validator bodies. The replacement delta-pass rule is also absent. These omissions prevent completing the required laundering, option-bypass, Bash-preservation, and lost-enforcement checks; supplied test claims cannot close them.
findings.smallest_fix: Append those exact implementations, ledger rows, and operative replacement rule as frozen review context.

findings.failure_path: Both '/usr/bin/nohup make test >log 2>&1 &' and 'nohup>log make test &' launch through nohup but remain silent: the regex rejects the preceding slash and adjacent redirection operator. These are direct commands, outside the documented quoted-launcher limitation.
findings.smallest_fix: Recognize path-qualified executable names and adjacent redirections while preserving quoted-mention suppression; add both command forms to the hook tests.

skipped_clients.reason: claude belongs to the implementer model family

concern_results.conclusion: Static inspection found two evidence-gate bypasses and ordinary detach spellings that suppress the advisory. Controller option handling, OpenCode command preservation, and the retired binder’s complete enforcement remain unverified because their implementations are omitted.
